contracts.name: V1 CTF Exchange
contracts.role: order-matching exchange (emits OrderFilled/OrdersMatched)

contracts.name: V1 Neg Risk CTF Exchange
contracts.role: order-matching exchange (emits OrderFilled/OrdersMatched)

contracts.name: CTF Exchange (2026)
contracts.role: order-matching exchange (emits OrderFilled/OrdersMatched)

contracts.name: Neg Risk CTF Exchange (2026)
contracts.role: order-matching exchange (emits OrderFilled/OrdersMatched)

contracts.name: ExchangeV3
contracts.role: order-matching exchange (emits OrderFilled/OrdersMatched)

contracts.name: Conditional Tokens (Gnosis CTF)
contracts.role: ERC-1155 position token for V1 and 2026 exchanges; split/merge/redeem/resolution events

contracts.name: PositionManager
contracts.role: ERC-1155 position token of ExchangeV3 (token id top byte = module: 1 or 3 seen)

contracts.name: Neg Risk Adapter
contracts.role: wraps USDC.e into WrappedCollateral, splits/merges/converts/redeems neg-risk positions; getCtf() of V1 Neg Risk exchange

contracts.name: Wrapped Collateral (wcol)
contracts.role: ERC-20 collateral that CTF sees for neg-risk conditions (PositionSplit collateralToken word)

contracts.name: USDC.e
contracts.role: V1 collateral (getCollateral of both V1 exchanges); also pUSD backing asset

contracts.name: pUSD
contracts.role: collateral of 2026 exchanges and ExchangeV3; emits Wrapped/Unwrapped

contracts.name: pUSD USDC.e reserve
contracts.role: receives USDC.e on wrap, pays USDC.e on unwrap

contracts.name: CollateralOnramp
contracts.role: caller of pUSD.Wrapped for deposits

contracts.name: CollateralOfframp
contracts.role: caller of pUSD.Unwrapped for withdrawals

contracts.name: CtfCollateralAdapter
contracts.role: user-facing redeem/merge for binary CTF markets with pUSD; CTF PayoutRedemption redeemer is this adapter, not the user

contracts.name: NegRiskCtfCollateralAdapter
contracts.role: user-facing convert/merge/redeem for neg-risk with pUSD; NRA events carry this adapter as stakeholder

contracts.name: other adapter-like addresses (unlabelled)
contracts.role: callers of pUSD.Wrapped/Unwrapped inside trades

contracts.name: other adapter-like addresses (unlabelled)
contracts.role: callers of pUSD.Wrapped/Unwrapped inside trades

contracts.name: fee receiver 2026/V3
contracts.role: FeeCharged receiver; receives the pUSD fee directly

contracts.name: V1 FeeModule (CTF)
contracts.role: operator; FeeCharged receiver; emits FeeRefunded(bytes32,address,uint256,uint256,uint256)

contracts.name: V1 FeeModule (Neg Risk)
contracts.role: operator; FeeCharged receiver; emits FeeRefunded(bytes32,address,uint256,uint256,uint256)

contracts.name: V1 older fee operator (Neg Risk)
contracts.role: operator in March 2025; emits FeeRefunded(address,address,uint256,uint256) (no indexed fields)

contracts.name: Polymarket Proxy Wallet Factory
contracts.role: getProxyFactory() of V1 and 2026 CTF exchanges

contracts.name: Gnosis Safe factory (Polymarket)
contracts.role: getSafeFactory() of V1 and 2026 CTF exchanges

contracts.name: ExchangeV3 modules (unlabelled)
contracts.role: emit unknown events 0xb6a6b8b1.. / 0x51c89d7e.. in V3 fills (address prefix 0x1.. / 0x3.. matches module byte 1 / 3)

contracts.name: ExchangeV3 modules (unlabelled)
contracts.role: emit unknown events 0xb6a6b8b1.. / 0x51c89d7e.. in V3 fills (address prefix 0x1.. / 0x3.. matches module byte 1 / 3)
